== statistical analysis ==

I am still trying to think of a good way to organize these.  While doing them on a per-book basis is definitely interesting, I was thinking it may be best to move them to individual ==Book Title== sections on a central [[statistical analysis]] page.  Then we can also include more things such as combined statistics for the entire series, pretty charts and graphs, etc.

Are you any good with a spreadsheet such as OpenOffice.org Calc or MS Excel?  It may be best to pool all the data into one of those until we decide how to best present it with wiki markup. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 05:06, 7 Nov 2005 (UTC)
